queries_run: Lam Research market share etch deposition 2026 gaining OR losing
Lam Research China domestic etch competitor NAURA AMEC displace 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 列示主要對手：沉積為 Applied Materials；ALD/PECVD 另有 ASM International、Wonik IPS；蝕刻為 Applied、Hitachi、Tokyo Electron；濕洗為 Screen、Semes、Tokyo Electron。
findings.excerpt: Our primary competitor in the dielectric and metals deposition market is Applied Materials, Inc. For ALD and PECVD, we also compete against ASM International and Wonik IPS. In the etch market, our primary competitors are Applied Materials, Inc.; Hitachi, Ltd.; and Tokyo Electron, Ltd.

findings.claim: 10-K 指出中國本土設備商可能因在地化政策加劇競爭，且美國出口管制使不受限的國際對手取得優勢。
findings.excerpt: Government and other initiatives to encourage local semiconductor manufacturing and supply chain in countries outside of the U.S., including China, could increase competition from domestic equipment and spare parts manufacturers in those countries.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：若無法跟上 AI 需求擴產，可能流失市占。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: If we are unable to effectively scale our business to meet our customers’ requirements in response to AI-driven demand, we may lose market share

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋摘要稱 Lam 2025 年 WFE SAM 占比達 mid-30s%（目標 high-30s）、出貨占比年增逾 1 個百分點，未見任何來源報告 Lam 在蝕刻/沉積失去份額；NAURA／AMEC 在中國擴張。皆為次級摘要無逐字原文，列為 clues。

clues.claim: Lam 管理層稱 2025 年 SAM 占 WFE 達 mid-thirties%，朝 high-thirties 目標前進；出貨占比年增逾 1 個百分點。
clues.source: Lam Research Q2 2026 (Dec-quarter 2025) earnings call transcript, AOL

clues.claim: NAURA 2025 年全球設備銷售排名升至第五，中國本土蝕刻/沉積業者擴張。
clues.source: China Daily via SSE: Three Chinese firms enter world semiconductor industry top 20
